title: Select the Rotation Match and Recolor It
written_solution: Use the top-left reference object as a shape template. Find the object elsewhere in the grid whose binary shape matches the reference under rotation, crop it, and recolor all its nonzero cells to the target color from the top-right corner.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (nonzero-cells grid) (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0))) (grid-positions grid))) (define (crop-nonzero grid) (let ((cells (nonzero-cells grid))) (if (empty? cells) (list (list 0)) (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))) (subgrid grid (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)))))) (define (e8b-list< a b) (cond ((empty? a) #f) ((< (first a) (first b)) #t) ((> (first a) (first b)) #f) (else (e8b-list< (rest a) (rest b))))) (define (f14b-binary-crop grid) (crop-nonzero (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid) (lambda (r c) (if (= (at grid r c) 0) 0 1))))) (define (f14b-rotations grid) (let loop ((cur (f14b-binary-crop grid)) (n 0) (acc (list))) (if (= n 4) (remove-duplicates (reverse acc)) (loop (rotate-cw cur) (+ n 1) (cons cur acc))))) (define (s17b-object-crop grid obj) (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj))) (subgrid grid (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)))) (define (s17b-object< a b) (let ((ba (obj-bbox a)) (bb (obj-bbox b))) (e8b-list< (list (first ba) (second ba)) (list (first bb) (second bb))))) (define (s17b-largest-object objs) (first (sort objs (lambda (a b) (let ((ba (obj-bbox a)) (bb (obj-bbox b))) (or (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)) (and (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b)) (e8b-list< (list (first ba) (second ba)) (list (first bb) (second bb)))))))))) (define (s17b-recolor grid color) (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid) (lambda (r c) (if (= (at grid r c) 0) 0 color)))) (define (s17b-same-under-rotation? a b) (member? (f14b-binary-crop a) (f14b-rotations b))) (let* ((target (at g 0 (- (cols g) 1))) (work0 (set-cell g 0 (- (cols g) 1) 0)) (ref (s17b-largest-object (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 1)) (objects work0 0)))) (ref-obj (s17b-object-crop work0 ref)) (work (paint-cells work0 (obj-cells ref) 0)) (candidates (sort (objects work 0) s17b-object<)) (hit (first (filter (lambda (obj) (s17b-same-under-rotation? ref-obj (s17b-object-crop work obj))) candidates)))) (s17b-recolor (s17b-object-crop work hit) target))))
